hypothesis: A bounded source-only baseline comparison design can turn M2498/M2499 diagnostic telemetry into a controlled engineering comparison protocol without changing actor inputs or overstating driver performance.

design preserves P0 observation shape 72 and action shape 3
design keeps role fixture hidden diagnostics oracle labels TTC required clearance reward terms and success labels out of actor input
design defines implementation preflight artifacts row gates and audit gates
design registers a bounded follow-up milestone
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution policy action training ranking winner success-rate or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2500 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2500 changes actor input or action contract

M2500 treats source-only baseline comparison design as driver performance

decision_rule: M2500 passes if it designs a bounded source-only baseline comparison protocol and registers a follow-up implementation or synthesis route without external simulation, policy action, training, ranking, winner selection, success-rate, or verdict claims.
